craft_notes: Sthāyin: variety fits. Rows: rule then menagerie. Read aloud: bestiary roll.

lines: Thus in the built causation the manifold kinds among reals the scripture speaks — that too fits —
dung-born worms, yogin's wish, spell, herbs: as grubs to scorpions.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ kalpite 'smin kāryatve śāstreṣu tattvānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ prati yat bahuprakāratvaṃ tad api saṃgataṃ gomayāt kīṭāt yogīcchāto mantrād auṣadhāt vṛścikodayavat
